purpose: Prospectively test complete 512-token hypothesis-only transport on new DBTL states while adding non-sensitive structured failure telemetry without changing provider behavior.

review_rubric.grounded: The hypothesis uses facts present in the new aggregate state and preserves its claim boundary.
review_rubric.actionable: The hypothesis specifies one concrete candidate-strategy or evidence operation with a checkable result.
review_rubric.incremental_value: The hypothesis adds a useful discriminator, audit, or design consideration beyond the hidden deterministic baseline plan.
review_rubric.scope_compliant: The reviewer assigns exactly one scope tag predeclared for the case.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: No interface result is interpretable until the selected coordinate model matches the manifest.

expected.baseline_plan: Resolve and freeze the intended coordinate-model index before prediction.
expected.rationale: The parser and manifest select different models with materially different interfaces.

fixture_proposal.reason: The manifest selects model 1 while the parser used model 0, and their interface-contact counts differ 54 versus 9 despite matching chain counts.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Within provenance_audit, compare coordinate hashes and per-model chain residue ranges against the manifest to determine whether zero-based indexing or an upstream model-selection rewrite caused the mismatch.

review.notes: Adds a concrete discriminator between indexing and upstream rewrite causes.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: A dimer prediction cannot validate the declared tetrameric biological assembly.

expected.baseline_plan: Reconstruct and validate the declared biological assembly before candidate analysis.
expected.rationale: The prediction omits half of the declared assembly.

fixture_proposal.reason: The declared A2B2 assembly contains four chains and two assembly operators, but the predictor received only A and B and recovered little native interface.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Audit the assembly-operator expansion by materializing the four expected chain transforms and checking whether the omitted symmetry mates contribute the native contacts missing from the two-chain input.

review.notes: Tests whether omitted symmetry mates specifically explain native-interface loss.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Identifier disjointness does not establish temporal independence when the template index is newer than the cutoff.

expected.baseline_plan: Rebuild a cutoff-consistent template index and invalidate the current certificate.
expected.rationale: Seventeen held-out items access templates released after the declared cutoff.

fixture_proposal.reason: The template index postdates the declared cutoff by more than a year and supplies 17 post-cutoff hits up to 0.88 identity despite zero candidate-ID overlap.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Within provenance_audit, reconstruct each template hit's release-date lineage and compare the certificate before and after removing all post-cutoff entries to quantify temporal leakage.

review.notes: Adds a paired before/after leakage quantification rather than only rebuilding.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: A vector-derived query extension invalidates attribution of native failure to predictor capability.

expected.baseline_plan: Regenerate the alignment from the exact target sequence without the linker.
expected.rationale: The query includes eight non-target residues while the native control fails.

fixture_proposal.reason: The alignment query is eight residues longer than the target, with an exact shared prefix and a documented vector-linker extension, while native recovery is poor.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Compare paired alignment coverage and inter-chain coevolution scores before and after removing the eight-residue extension to test whether linker-derived columns distort pairing or attention at the native interface.

review.notes: Adds a checkable representation-level consequence of the known query mismatch.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Row-level resampling understates uncertainty when scaffold families dominate the evidence.

expected.baseline_plan: Replace row bootstrap with scaffold-cluster resampling before certification.
expected.rationale: Cluster-aware uncertainty is more than three times wider.

fixture_proposal.reason: Six scaffold clusters generate 240 rows, one cluster supplies 46 percent, within-cluster outcomes agree at 0.91, and cluster bootstrap triples interval width.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Estimate leave-one-scaffold-cluster-out certificate stability and identify whether any single cluster changes the upper risk bound across the target threshold.

review.notes: Adds influence analysis beyond replacing the bootstrap unit.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Binary calibration near an assay ceiling cannot distinguish true high values from censored measurements.

expected.baseline_plan: Suspend threshold calibration and obtain an assay range that resolves ceiling values.
expected.rationale: More than one third of rows are censored immediately above the success threshold.

fixture_proposal.reason: Twenty-nine of 84 measurements sit at the assay ceiling only 0.5 units above the success threshold, and their apparent success rate is fourfold higher than uncensored rows.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Reassay a stratified subset of ceiling-valued and near-ceiling rows using a wider dynamic range, then test how interval-censored labels alter the calibrated risk curve.

review.notes: Adds a stratified reassay and interval-censoring sensitivity analysis.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Candidate discrimination cannot be separated from plate effects in the current layout.

expected.baseline_plan: Collect plate-balanced replicate controls before trusting the assay label.
expected.rationale: Residualizing the unrandomized plate effect removes most apparent discrimination.

fixture_proposal.reason: Plate 7 contains 63 percent of positives and has a 1.8-SD control shift; AUROC drops from 0.81 to 0.56 after plate residualization.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Run a blocked replicate in which high- and low-scoring candidates are randomized across all eight plates and compare within-plate versus pooled effect estimates.

review.notes: Specifies a blocked design and the within-plate comparison needed to separate signal from batch.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: A single control scaffold cannot establish specificity across five candidate scaffold classes.

expected.baseline_plan: Add scaffold-matched negative controls before interpreting specificity.
expected.rationale: Current controls cover only 27 percent of the candidate feature hull.

fixture_proposal.reason: Eighteen negative controls come from one scaffold class while candidates span five classes and only 27 percent of their feature hull is covered.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Collect negative controls matched to each missing scaffold class and compare class-conditional false-positive rates under the unchanged assay protocol.

review.notes: Correct and checkable, but it closely restates the deterministic baseline.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Nominal sequence uniqueness does not establish independent interface exploration.

expected.baseline_plan: Stop scaling the current generator and diversify interface-pattern families.
expected.rationale: Eighty-three candidates occupy one near-duplicate cluster and only seven interface patterns are present.

fixture_proposal.reason: The set has 151 unique sequences but an effective count of 24, one 83-member high-identity cluster, and only seven distinct interface patterns.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Partition candidates jointly by sequence identity and interface-contact pattern, then seed the next generation from underrepresented joint clusters rather than sequence-unique representatives alone.

review.notes: Adds a joint sequence-interface diversity criterion beyond generic diversification.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Geometric acceptance alone does not establish a physically supported charged interface.

expected.baseline_plan: Test a charge-balanced candidate strategy while preserving geometric constraints.
expected.rationale: Geometry-passing candidates have large uncompensated interface charge and weak predicted interfaces.

fixture_proposal.reason: Among 46 geometry-passing candidates, the median interface charge is +8 versus +1 native, with five buried charges, no median salt bridges, and 67 percent high PAE.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Generate a matched candidate slice that preserves backbone and contact geometry while constraining buried-charge compensation, then compare interface PAE and salt-bridge formation against the current slice.

review.notes: Defines a matched intervention that isolates electrostatic compensation from geometry.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: High monomer confidence cannot validate an unsatisfied covalent interface constraint.

expected.baseline_plan: Redesign or remove the disulfide constraint before scaling.
expected.rationale: Most constrained candidates miss the target sulfur geometry despite stable monomers.

fixture_proposal.reason: Only 18 percent of 38 constrained candidates form the intended disulfide; median sulfur distance is 6.9 A rather than 2.1 A while monomers remain confident.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Stratify failures by backbone sulfur-distance feasibility before sequence design and test whether prefiltering to geometrically feasible backbones raises disulfide formation without changing monomer confidence.

review.notes: Adds a pre-sequence backbone feasibility discriminator.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Intended-complex success does not establish specificity when self-association is stronger.

expected.baseline_plan: Add negative-design pressure against candidate homodimers before selection.
expected.rationale: Homodimer success exceeds intended heterodimer success in the same candidate set.

fixture_proposal.reason: Thirty-four of 64 candidates support homodimers versus 21 intended heterodimers, with a median self-association score advantage of 0.17 despite a valid native control.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Within candidate_strategy, identify residues contributing contacts unique to the homodimer models and penalize those contacts in a matched redesign while preserving heterodimer hotspot interactions.

review.notes: Adds model-derived negative-design residues rather than a generic specificity penalty.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: One global repeatability summary cannot justify single-seed ranking for heteroskedastic candidates.

expected.baseline_plan: Use candidate-adaptive replicate prediction for high-variance cases.
expected.rationale: A high-variance candidate tail destabilizes single-seed ranking.

fixture_proposal.reason: Median seed variability is low, but the top decile reaches 0.21 SD and single-seed rank correlation is 0.71 versus 0.93 for five-seed means.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Test a two-stage predictor protocol that adds four seeds only when the first two disagree above a preregistered threshold, measuring retained rank correlation and compute cost.

review.notes: Specifies an adaptive replicate rule and a cost-quality outcome.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: High score correlation does not preserve a certificate when labels change across predictor versions.

expected.baseline_plan: Pin the certified predictor or revalidate the new version before use.
expected.rationale: Version drift changes 22 percent of binary labels under the unchanged threshold.

fixture_proposal.reason: The active container differs from the certified digest; versions correlate at 0.89 but agree on only 78 percent of thresholded labels.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Run a hash-bound bridge panel enriched for candidates near the frozen threshold and estimate direction-specific label transitions between versions before deciding whether recalibration is sufficient.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: A fixed recycle budget does not produce comparable endpoint evidence for nonconverged candidates.

expected.baseline_plan: Treat convergence state explicitly and test a bounded adaptive recycle protocol.
expected.rationale: One quarter of candidates remain nonconverged and have much weaker interfaces.

fixture_proposal.reason: Only 74 percent converge by recycle 8; the remaining tail has median interface PAE 18.7 versus 7.9 and only 8 percent success.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: For the nonconverged tail, add recycles in fixed increments under a hard cap and test whether PAE trajectories stabilize or merely select intrinsically difficult candidates.

review.notes: Distinguishes recoverable convergence from intrinsic difficulty using trajectories.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: The tested computational families do not support selective trust; only a preregistered orthogonal measurement can reopen the question.

expected.baseline_plan: Preserve the computational null and preregister one orthogonal assay endpoint.
expected.rationale: Four powered, clean computational feature families remain near chance across ten targets.

fixture_proposal.reason: Across ten powered targets, four clean computational feature families remain between 0.46 and 0.55 AUROC while controls and provenance pass.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Preregister the available orthogonal assay on a held-out target-balanced subset and test whether its measurement ranks outcomes without combining it post hoc with the null computational features.

review.notes: Specifies a held-out, target-balanced assay test and prevents post-hoc feature rescue.
